name: Hidan

entries.name: Revenge
entries.text: +2d6 bonus damage to any creature that harmed Hidan last round.

entries.name: Reckless
entries.text: At the start of your turn, gain advantage on melee attack rolls or damage rolls; enemies gain the same against you.

entries.name: Press the Attack
entries.text: +2 to Taijutsu attacks against creatures benefiting from AC bonuses from jutsu this round.

entries.name: Grim
entries.text: Mark a creature. If its HP is below 50%, your attacks deal +2d8 necrotic damage. Only one creature may be marked at a time.

entries.name: Chakra Weapons
entries.text: Weapons count as chakra-enhanced, gaining +2 to hit and damage.

entries.name: Cunning Action
entries.text: Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.

entries.name: Fortitous
entries.text: On a Constitution saving throw, if you would pass, you take no damage and ignore its effects.

entries.name: Stalwart
entries.text: Advantage against forced movement. You can't suffer penalties on such rolls.

entries.name: Immortal Spirit
entries.text: While a creature is Marked and Hidan is within the Jashin Ritual circle, he cannot be reduced below 1 HP.

entries.name: Jashin Ritual
entries.text: As an action, Hidan deals weapon damage and creates a 5 ft. blood circle. Targets are Marked for Pain.

entries.name: Jashin's Judgement
entries.text: While inside the ritual circle, Hidan can damage himself to also damage the Marked creature. Only the Marked creature suffers any additional effects.

entries.name: Striker Passive 1
entries.text: Once per turn, weapon, Taijutsu, and Bukijutsu damage ignores 10 DR.

entries.name: Striker Passive 2
entries.text: Once per turn, weapon, Taijutsu, and Bukijutsu damage ignores temporary hit points.

entries.name: Striker Action
entries.text: Cost: 4 Tenacity dice. Overpower a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu, adding the dice to its damage. Creatures make their saves at -1d4. On a critical hit, increase the damage die size by one step.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: Make 3 melee attacks or 4 ranged attacks with shuriken.

entries.name: Triple-Bladed Scythe
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) slashing damage.

entries.name: Shuriken
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) slashing damage.
Hidan may take 1 Elite Action at the end of another creature's turn to move, attack, cast a jutsu, or gain an extra reaction. He regains all Elite Actions at the start of his turn.

notes: "Undead" occupies the clan slot of the header; it is not a clan in the rules. The trait name "Fortitous" is kept as printed (a Fortitude/Fortuitous pun in the source). The Shuriken attack's damage type is printed as slashing; kept as printed.
